+def _freeze_container(root):
+    """Convert mutable staging containers back to tuple/frozenset shapes iteratively."""
+    # Tuples are staged as lists; nested tuples are converted in-place bottom-up.
+    stack = [(root, False)]
+    built = {}
+    while stack:
+        obj, visited = stack.pop()
+        if isinstance(obj, (list, dict, set)):
+            if not visited:
+                stack.append((obj, True))
+                values = obj.values() if isinstance(obj, dict) else obj
+                for child in values:
